segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // This example code appears in a subclass of UIViewController that conforms to // UIColorPickerViewControllerDelegate. func presentColorPicker() { let colorPicker = UIColorPickerViewController() colorPicker.title = "Background Color" colorPicker.supportsAlpha = false colorPicker.delegate = self colorPicker.modalPresentationStyle = .popover colorPicker.popoverPresentationController?.sourceItem = self.navigationItem.rightBarButtonItem self.present(colorPicker, animated: true) } ```
